relationships.subject: harmaline
relationships.evidence_quote: co-administration of sub-effective doses of harmaline (5 mg/kg) and morphine (2 mg/kg) induced antinociception

relationships.subject: muscimol
relationships.evidence_quote: Intra-vHip microinjection of muscimol (0, 200 and 300 ng/mice), a GABA-A receptor agonist, enhanced the anti-nociceptive effects of harmaline (2.5 mg/kg)+morphine (2 mg/kg) combination

relationships.subject: bicuculline
relationships.evidence_quote: Bicuculline (60 and 100 ng/mouse, intra-vHip) was administered with the harmaline (5 mg/kg)+morphine (2 mg/kg), and inhibited the potentiating effect of harmaline on morphine response

relationships.subject: vHip GABA-A receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: GABAergic mechanisms in the vHip facilitate harmaline-induced potentiation of morphine response in the tail-flick test in part through GABA-A receptors

key_findings: Sub-effective harmaline plus morphine produces antinociception in the tail-flick test in mice.
Intra-vHip GABA-A agonist muscimol enhances, and antagonist bicuculline blocks, harmaline potentiation of morphine antinociception.
